## D04

this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

generic safety language is not unlimited authority to demand more process.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>One exact adequate discriminator can suffice even for a narrow high-stakes claim, with applicable duties intact.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen for changed hazard boundary, invalidated discriminator, authority or credible latent consumer.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X05</p></li><li><p>X09</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D33

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D33</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/32</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-AC</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D33</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Attention and maintenance are safety-portfolio resources</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>JOINT_RESOURCE_CONSTRAINT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-34</p></li><li><p>ECSE-35</p></li><li><p>ECSE-38</p></li><li><p>ECSE-45</p></li><li><p>ECSE-56</p></li><li><p>ECSE-59</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-015</p></li><li><p>ESS-020</p></li><li><p>ESS-031</p></li><li><p>ESS-040</p></li><li><p>ESS-046</p></li><li><p>ESS-047</p></li><li><p>ESS-048</p></li><li><p>ESS-056</p></li><li><p>ESS-063</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Does additional assurance displace an equally necessary control action?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Analysis, reading, explanation and duplicate checking consume the same people and time as response, learning and maintenance, limiting feasible portfolios.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The actual named resources are shared; a generic statement that everything costs time is insufficient.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>The omitted check must genuinely be dispensable or supplied by an adequate substitute; mandatory work cannot simply be waived.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>With sufficient independent competent capacity, additional useful review can be feasible. A compact durable record can preserve the needed function.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen for shared deadlines, changed staff capacity or a newly material omitted uncertainty.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X04</p></li><li><p>X09</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D34

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D34</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/33</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-CA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D34</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Latent safety roles prevent premature simplification</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>LOSS_AND_LATENT_CONSUMER_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-015</p></li><li><p>ESS-020</p></li><li><p>ESS-022</p></li><li><p>ESS-024</p></li><li><p>ESS-031</p></li><li><p>ESS-040</p></li><li><p>ESS-046</p></li><li><p>ESS-047</p></li><li><p>ESS-048</p></li><li><p>ESS-056</p></li><li><p>ESS-063</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-34</p></li><li><p>ECSE-35</p></li><li><p>ECSE-38</p></li><li><p>ECSE-45</p></li><li><p>ECSE-56</p></li><li><p>ECSE-59</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>What function is lost if this support or artifact is removed?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Hazard purpose, required independence and credible later verification/accountability can keep a compact support necessary even without recent action changes.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The cognitive artifact, check or method actually supports the named safety role.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>A speculative indefinite use does not justify all retention; larger documents are not better assurance.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Remove obsolete or duplicated work when the remaining arrangement is adequate and duties permit it.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after new dependency, hazard, retention duty or evidence of harmful burden.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X09</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D35

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D35</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/34</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-AB</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D35</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Contemporaneous work supplies causal rivals and observation conditions</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>CAUSAL_DESIGN_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-32</p></li><li><p>ECSE-39</p></li><li><p>ECSE-40</p></li><li><p>ECSE-58</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P013</p></li><li><p>P014</p></li><li><p>P029</p></li><li><p>P039</p></li><li><p>P046</p></li><li><p>P051</p></li><li><p>P052</p></li><li><p>P053</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Could the observed change reflect the work, evaluator or reporting process?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Local information, constraints, incentives and adaptation supply specific rival mechanisms, selection conditions and time ordering for causal or evaluator analysis.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The inference concerns a human/system event or intervention with those recorded conditions.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>A plausible systems story is not causal proof or automatic exoneration; individual action/accountability remains examinable.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>An unambiguous directly observed local mechanism can justify a small repair without exhaustive organizational modeling.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after contradictory contemporaneous evidence or a plausible omitted causal path.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X08</p></li><li><p>X09</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

<a id="r-c1ded8b60ca5b4e1"></a>
## D36

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D36</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/35</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D36</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Causal and selection discipline limits system narratives</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>CAUSAL_EVIDENCE_CONSTRAINT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P013</p></li><li><p>P014</p></li><li><p>P029</p></li><li><p>P030</p></li><li><p>P039</p></li><li><p>P040</p></li><li><p>P046</p></li><li><p>P051</p></li><li><p>P052</p></li><li><p>P053</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-32</p></li><li><p>ECSE-39</p></li><li><p>ECSE-40</p></li><li><p>ECSE-58</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Which explanation and corrective claim follows from the recorded events?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Selection, confounding, interference, evaluator changes and prospective comparisons distinguish a mechanism hypothesis from an established causal improvement.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The cognitive investigation makes an empirical causal or intervention-effect claim.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Complete reconstruction is rarely available; evidence limits do not forbid separately justified temporary containment.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>A targeted deterministic discriminator may decide one cause; an unchanged immediate action does not make inquiry worthless.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen for new confounding, reporting changes, implementation failure or adverse outcomes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X08</p></li><li><p>X09</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

<a id="r-6ad1be13d317c99c"></a>
## D37

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D37</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/36</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-AC</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D37</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Work-as-performed refines safety investigation</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>HUMAN_CAUSAL_MECHANISM_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-32</p></li><li><p>ECSE-39</p></li><li><p>ECSE-40</p></li><li><p>ECSE-58</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-039</p></li><li><p>ESS-040</p></li><li><p>ESS-041</p></li><li><p>ESS-042</p></li><li><p>ESS-043</p></li><li><p>ESS-059</p></li><li><p>ESS-065</p></li><li><p>ESS-066</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>How did information, goals and practical constraints shape the action?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Contemporaneous local context and affected burdens refine a hazard-control explanation and prevent a human-error label from closing remaining causal questions.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The loss or precursor involves the identified work or organizational decision.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Context does not erase culpability, establish all causes or imply that adaptation maintained safety.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>A simple direct individual act can be a real cause; broad system analysis is not always needed to make the next justified change.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after evidence contradicts the proposed local rationale or control mechanism.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X08</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D38

a culture score or diagram is not a causal mechanism.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Learning or accountability may justify inquiry even when the immediate action stays unchanged; no change can be a reasoned outcome.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen for failed implementation, adverse evidence or newly exposed competing losses.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X08</p></li><li><p>X09</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D39

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D39</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/38</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BC</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D39</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Observation and metric scope constrain safety-learning claims</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>MEASUREMENT_CAUSAL_AND_PROXY_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P001</p></li><li><p>P004</p></li><li><p>P008</p></li><li><p>P013</p></li><li><p>P023</p></li><li><p>P025</p></li><li><p>P029</p></li><li><p>P030</p></li><li><p>P039</p></li><li><p>P040</p></li><li><p>P046</p></li><li><p>P047</p></li><li><p>P050</p></li><li><p>P051</p></li><li><p>P052</p></li><li><p>P053</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-039</p></li><li><p>ESS-040</p></li><li><p>ESS-041</p></li><li><p>ESS-042</p></li><li><p>ESS-043</p></li><li><p>ESS-055</p></li><li><p>ESS-058</p></li><li><p>ESS-059</p></li><li><p>ESS-065</p></li><li><p>ESS-066</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>What does a count, score, disagreement or trend show about control?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Construct validity, exposure, selection, grouping and evaluator/causal distinctions block the conversion of a favorable metric into proof of control or accident prevention.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>That count/score/trend is actually cited in the safety investigation, indicator or organizational inference.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Statistical adjustment does not create missing mechanism evidence or determine legitimate risk acceptance.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>A valid long exposure with no events can update a scoped bound; ## D57

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D57</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/56</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BC</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D57</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Sequential guarantees constrain continuing assurance evidence</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>SEQUENTIAL_EVIDENCE_SCOPE_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P037</p></li><li><p>P038</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-030</p></li><li><p>ESS-045</p></li><li><p>ESS-051</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>What can a repeatedly inspected stream claim over time?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The actual selection family, process/filtration and time-uniform guarantee limit repeated assurance conclusions; a valid confidence sequence need not imply instantaneous state detection or timely action.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The assurance claim uses repeated statistical conclusions from the same stream under the declared guarantee.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Physical envelope inclusion, causal interpretation and control deadlines remain; no universal iid or fixed-horizon requirement is imposed.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>A fixed-horizon design or direct state invariant can suffice. <dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D92</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/91</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-CB</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D92</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Credited control function defines the future regime question</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>MISSION_AND_HORIZON_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-009</p></li><li><p>ESS-010</p></li><li><p>ESS-011</p></li><li><p>ESS-034</p></li><li><p>ESS-045</p></li><li><p>ESS-050</p></li><li><p>ESS-053</p></li><li><p>ESS-016</p></li><li><p>ESS-035</p></li><li><p>ESS-036</p></li><li><p>ESS-037</p></li><li><p>ESS-054</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P018</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>What future behavior must this capability or response prediction support?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The actual feedback state, mode, temporal constraint, alarm event, adaptive envelope, margin or integrated acceptance claim supplies the regime and horizon whose performance matters. The actual role, containment horizon, degraded mission, restart state or temporary configuration defines the prediction target; it does not establish stability.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>P018 predicts the same control or observation process; an unrelated normative safety statement supplies no statistical regime.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>The required prediction domain does not establish stability, valid data or a correct dynamic law.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Use a direct bounded assurance claim when it settles the need; do not manufacture a long-run model.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after changed mission, state variable, mode or latest useful action time.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y04</p></li><li><p>X02</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd><dt>Additional member reason</dt><dd><ol><li><p>The actual role, containment horizon, degraded mission, restart state or temporary configuration defines the prediction target; it does not establish stability.</p></li></ol></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D93

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D93</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/92</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BC</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D93</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Change discrimination informs monitored modes and adaptation</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>MONITORING_DISCRIMINATION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P015</p></li><li><p>P021</p></li><li><p>P022</p></li><li><p>P024</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-010</p></li><li><p>ESS-045</p></li><li><p>ESS-003</p></li><li><p>ESS-016</p></li><li><p>ESS-036</p></li><li><p>ESS-037</p></li><li><p>ESS-054</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>What observed departure warrants a state-model or envelope response?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>P015 supplies a calibrated change distinction; P021 its false-alarm/miss/delay tradeoff; P022 its dynamic-baseline validity; P024 the incremental discrimination of a specialized monitor. Each constrains the same claimed monitoring response. These members are included only at that stated monitoring facet; a direct invariant supplies no statistical-monitor obligation.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The receiver uses that monitor to detect departure in its process model or operating envelope; every source retains its own narrower criterion.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Detection is not causal diagnosis, physical control, complete unknown-hazard discovery or permission to adapt.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Direct state observation, a known deterministic discontinuity, or a fixed passive envelope can suffice.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after mode, baseline, delay, event population or monitoring purpose changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y01</p></li><li><p>Y04</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd><dt>Additional member reason</dt><dd><ol><li><p>The same detector can supply explicit required state/assumption feedback for an enforced constraint, human control path, degraded mode, restart or temporary state. These members are included only at that stated monitoring facet; a direct invariant supplies no statistical-monitor obligation.</p></li></ol></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D94

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D94</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/93</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-CB</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D94</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Control-state use specifies monitor conditions</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>MONITOR_TARGET_AND_ACTION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-009</p></li><li><p>ESS-010</p></li><li><p>ESS-045</p></li><li><p>ESS-053</p></li><li><p>ESS-003</p></li><li><p>ESS-011</p></li><li><p>ESS-016</p></li><li><p>ESS-034</p></li><li><p>ESS-035</p></li><li><p>ESS-036</p></li><li><p>ESS-037</p></li><li><p>ESS-050</p></li><li><p>ESS-054</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P015</p></li><li><p>P021</p></li><li><p>P022</p></li><li><p>P024</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Which state, change and response make this monitor useful?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Feedback freshness and validity, process-model assumptions, observable envelope conditions and integrated-state acceptance identify the monitored quantity, relevant departure, response consumer or consequence. They change the appropriate baseline/detection tradeoff. No universal chart or full intervention study is required.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Reuse an adequate direct test or deterministic invariant instead of fitting an unnecessary monitor.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after altered state meaning, telemetry, response or mode.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y01</p></li><li><p>Y04</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd><dt>Additional member reason</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Each added control contributes its actual observed variable, response deadline, admissible action or required state to the same monitor; unavailable probability or calibration information is not inferred.</p></li></ol></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D95

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D95</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/94</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BC</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D95</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Natural control limits are not safety requirements</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>BOUNDARY_INTERPRETATION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P017</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-003</p></li><li><p>ESS-034</p></li><li><p>ESS-045</p></li><li><p>ESS-050</p></li><li><p>ESS-053</p></li><li><p>ESS-011</p></li><li><p>ESS-035</p></li><li><p>ESS-036</p></li><li><p>ESS-037</p></li><li><p>ESS-054</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Is this displayed process band being treated as an externally justified safety limit?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Separating natural variation, engineering specifications and uncertainty decision rules prevents a statistical control band from silently defining an enforceable constraint, alarm boundary, adaptive envelope, safety margin or acceptance criterion. A data-derived response-time band, containment band, degraded/restart limit or temporary-state limit must likewise be distinguished from its justified requirement when both appear in the same claim.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The same monitored characteristic has both a data-derived band and an external control requirement in the receiving claim.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>The statistical distinction does not justify the safety requirement, sensor, actuator or actual compliance.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>For an exact deterministic limit, use the requirement and an adequate direct check; no natural-process band is needed.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen when band provenance, limit meaning, uncertainty or requirement changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y01</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd><dt>Additional member reason</dt><dd><ol><li><p>A data-derived response-time band, containment band, degraded/restart limit or temporary-state limit must likewise be distinguished from its justified requirement when both appear in the same claim.</p></li></ol></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D96

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D96</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/95</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-CB</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D96</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Hazard-linked limits supply the specification side of the distinction</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>REQUIREMENT_PROVENANCE_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-003</p></li><li><p>ESS-034</p></li><li><p>ESS-045</p></li><li><p>ESS-050</p></li><li><p>ESS-053</p></li><li><p>ESS-011</p></li><li><p>ESS-035</p></li><li><p>ESS-036</p></li><li><p>ESS-037</p></li><li><p>ESS-054</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P017</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Which limit is a justified requirement rather than a description of past variation?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The actual enforceable constraint, alarm response objective, adaptive boundary, safety separation or acceptance criterion identifies the requirement and consumer against which P017 distinguishes process limits. These temporal, containment, degraded/restart or temporary-state requirements identify the specification side only when an actual monitored characteristic and natural band are present.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>That source genuinely sets or consumes the same characteristic’s limit; it does not acquire authority merely through a label.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Observed process variation, measurement uncertainty and decision-rule error still need separate evidence.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>A direct requirement check can suffice without a control chart or capability index.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after requirement, consequence, operating mode or authority changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y01</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd><dt>Additional member reason</dt><dd><ol><li><p>These temporal, containment, degraded/restart or temporary-state requirements identify the specification side only when an actual monitored characteristic and natural band are present.</p></li></ol></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D97

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D97</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/96</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D97</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Capability summaries do not by themselves warrant reliance</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>CAPABILITY_INTERPRETATION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P019</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-16</p></li><li><p>ECSE-29</p></li><li><p>ECSE-55</p></li><li><p>ECSE-17</p></li><li><p>ECSE-37</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Does this conformance index justify the reliance or capability-change claim being made?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The distribution, stability and measurement conditions of a capability index limit reliance credited to that same repeated conformance process; a sigma label cannot alone justify trust or changed confidence. A countermeasure or fallback claim using the same repeated conformance index inherits its scope limitations; a qualitative skill claim does not become an index.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The cognitive argument actually consumes a capability/conformance summary, not arbitrary human competence or a subjective trust score.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Appropriate task use, current performance, alternatives and consequences remain; P019 does not calibrate human trust.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Use direct yield, scenario-specific performance or a complete direct check when index assumptions fail.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen on changed distribution, specification, regime or use.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y04</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd><dt>Additional member reason</dt><dd><ol><li><p>A countermeasure or fallback claim using the same repeated conformance index inherits its scope limitations; a qualitative skill claim does not become an index.</p></li></ol></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D98

## D99

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D99</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/98</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BC</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D99</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Capability index scope limits credited conformance</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>CAPABILITY_EVIDENCE_SCOPE_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P019</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-034</p></li><li><p>ESS-045</p></li><li><p>ESS-050</p></li><li><p>ESS-053</p></li><li><p>ESS-003</p></li><li><p>ESS-011</p></li><li><p>ESS-035</p></li><li><p>ESS-036</p></li><li><p>ESS-037</p></li><li><p>ESS-054</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>What bounded conformance claim can the same process index support?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Conditional index interpretation limits alarm/envelope, margin and integrated-control claims that use the index as evidence of meeting a requirement. It cannot replace hazard coverage, control effectiveness or actual-state feedback. ## D100

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D100</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/99</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-CB</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D100</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Control acceptance gives capability its required boundary</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>CAPABILITY_SPECIFICATION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-034</p></li><li><p>ESS-045</p></li><li><p>ESS-050</p></li><li><p>ESS-053</p></li><li><p>ESS-003</p></li><li><p>ESS-011</p></li><li><p>ESS-035</p></li><li><p>ESS-036</p></li><li><p>ESS-037</p></li><li><p>ESS-054</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P019</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Which specification and loss make this conformance summary meaningful?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The hazard-linked alarm requirement, envelope, separation margin or integrated acceptance condition supplies the actual boundary and consumer for the same process capability calculation. ## D101

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D101</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/100</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D101</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Change evidence qualifies reliance and fallback recalibration</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>RELIABILITY_CHANGE_EVIDENCE_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P015</p></li><li><p>P021</p></li><li><p>P022</p></li><li><p>P024</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-16</p></li><li><p>ECSE-17</p></li><li><p>ECSE-29</p></li><li><p>ECSE-37</p></li><li><p>ECSE-55</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Is the same observed assistance or fallback process still performing as credited?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Calibrated change discrimination, alarm/delay economics, dynamic baselines and specialized detection provide distinct bounded inputs to warranted reliance, error countermeasures, reliability-change signalling and credited alternate-path performance. Rejecting a maximal-trust objective retains a conditional warranted-use decision; a change signal may inform that decision without becoming a trust score.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>That cognitive decision uses observations from the same assistance or fallback process and a relevant departure can change its use.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>A signal is not a cause, a trust score, actual fallback authority or evidence of whole-programme efficacy.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Stable validated operation, adequate direct checking or an obvious deterministic defect can make ongoing statistical monitoring unnecessary.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after context, event base rate, false alarms, delay or capability changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y04</p></li><li><p>X01</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd><dt>Additional member reason</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Rejecting a maximal-trust objective retains a conditional warranted-use decision; a change signal may inform that decision without becoming a trust score.</p></li></ol></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D102

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D102</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/101</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-AB</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D102</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Reliance and fallback purpose defines relevant change</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>MONITORING_DECISION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-16</p></li><li><p>ECSE-17</p></li><li><p>ECSE-29</p></li><li><p>ECSE-37</p></li><li><p>ECSE-55</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P015</p></li><li><p>P021</p></li><li><p>P022</p></li><li><p>P024</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Which assistance departure matters to the user’s actual decision?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The credited task reliability, omission/commission distinction, capability update and alternate-path mission identify the relevant event, usable signal, consequence or response cost for the same monitor. ## D103

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D103</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/102</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-CA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D103</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Safety response conditions constrain interruption timing</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>DEADLINE_AND_TRANSITION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-011</p></li><li><p>ESS-016</p></li><li><p>ESS-034</p></li><li><p>ESS-035</p></li><li><p>ESS-036</p></li><li><p>ESS-037</p></li><li><p>ESS-045</p></li><li><p>ESS-050</p></li><li><p>ESS-053</p></li><li><p>ESS-054</p></li><li><p>ESS-003</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-20</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>When must the ongoing task be interrupted or safely resumed?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The same response deadline, human control duty, actionable alarm, containment timing, degraded/restart condition, adaptive boundary, margin, integrated completion criterion or temporary transition supplies a latest start, ordering or state condition to the interruption decision. An enforced constraint can also supply a must-hold state or action-order condition for deferral/resumption when the same actor performs the constrained activity; no unstated numerical deadline is invented.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The safety response and displaced activity share the actor or a real resource dependency. Each source contributes only its actual temporal/state requirement.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Actual duration, priority, authorization, uncertain delays and resumption feasibility remain; the source does not prescribe a universal interruption schedule.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>A later deadline can permit deferral; separate competent resources, automatic protection or a simple direct action can remove the interruption conflict.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after changed deadline, response work, capacity, transition state or competing obligation.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y02</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd><dt>Additional member reason</dt><dd><ol><li><p>An enforced constraint can also supply a must-hold state or action-order condition for deferral/resumption when the same actor performs the constrained activity; no unstated numerical deadline is invented.</p></li></ol></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D106

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D106</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/105</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-AC</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D106</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Specific human capability limits credited constraints and monitoring</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>HUMAN_FEASIBILITY_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-14</p></li><li><p>ECSE-15</p></li><li><p>ECSE-21</p></li><li><p>ECSE-22</p></li><li><p>ECSE-33</p></li><li><p>ECSE-62</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-003</p></li><li><p>ESS-009</p></li><li><p>ESS-010</p></li><li><p>ESS-034</p></li><li><p>ESS-050</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Is the human work credited by this control actually feasible in the relevant conditions?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Complete takeover, retained skill, peak demand, vigilance or recoverable degradation contributes its own capability condition to the same enforced constraint, feedback path, process-model tracking, alarm or margin claim. The rejected universal workload-minimization claim contributes only its retained comparison of required work, underload and transition demand, not an obligation to maximize effort.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The receiving control explicitly depends on that particular human function; native skills, workload and vigilance are not treated as the same variable.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>The control’s physical realization, hazard coverage and evidence remain; no actual capacity value is supplied by a qualitative criterion.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Eliminate the unnecessary human duty or use an adequate direct, passive or automatic constraint.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after changed role, interruption, skill, mode or available resource.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X02</p></li><li><p>X04</p></li><li><p>Y02</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd><dt>Additional member reason</dt><dd><ol><li><p>The rejected universal workload-minimization claim contributes only its retained comparison of required work, underload and transition demand, not an obligation to maximize effort.</p></li></ol></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D107

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D107</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/106</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-CA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D107</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Credited control purpose defines required human work</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>CONTROL_DUTY_AND_OUTCOME_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-003</p></li><li><p>ESS-009</p></li><li><p>ESS-010</p></li><li><p>ESS-034</p></li><li><p>ESS-050</p></li><li><p>ESS-011</p></li><li><p>ESS-016</p></li><li><p>ESS-035</p></li><li><p>ESS-036</p></li><li><p>ESS-037</p></li><li><p>ESS-045</p></li><li><p>ESS-053</p></li><li><p>ESS-054</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-14</p></li><li><p>ECSE-15</p></li><li><p>ECSE-21</p></li><li><p>ECSE-22</p></li><li><p>ECSE-33</p></li><li><p>ECSE-62</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Which retained capability or workload tradeoff matters for this exact control?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The enforced constraint, required feedback, process mode, alarm response or margin defines what takeover, skill, reserve, vigilance, degradation or workload comparison must preserve. direct checks can avoid a large programme.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen when the control, required observation, mode or actual residual work changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X04</p></li><li><p>Y02</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd><dt>Additional member reason</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Timing, coordination, containment, degradation, restart, adaptation, integrated completion and lifecycle constraints also define the actual residual human work; each contributes only its named native duty/state facet.</p></li></ol></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D108

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D108</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/107</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D108</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Pre-treatment nuisance structure protects the actual cognitive comparison</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>DESIGN_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P031</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-16</p></li><li><p>ECSE-17</p></li><li><p>ECSE-41</p></li><li><p>ECSE-42</p></li><li><p>ECSE-43</p></li><li><p>ECSE-44</p></li><li><p>ECSE-46</p></li><li><p>ECSE-47</p></li><li><p>ECSE-48</p></li><li><p>ECSE-49</p></li><li><p>ECSE-50</p></li><li><p>ECSE-51</p></li><li><p>ECSE-53</p></li><li><p>ECSE-55</p></li><li><p>ECSE-56</p></li><li><p>ECSE-60</p></li><li><p>ECSE-62</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Could pre-existing user, team, task, site or event differences change this comparison?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Sparse pre-treatment blocking or stratification controls consequential known composition differences in the same empirical comparison, while preserving interactions and the intended distribution of benefit. For measurement constructs the input applies to the comparative interpretation, not to the construct’s definition.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The native claim is being supported by an actual empirical comparison of work, intervention, measure or outcome, with known consequential pre-treatment heterogeneity. No relation is asserted for a purely conceptual definition or one descriptive score.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Valid measures, treatment contrast, adequate units, carryover/interference, causal design and appropriate target weights remain. Post-treatment blocking is excluded.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Homogeneous units, an already adequate design, a clear bounded reversible effect or an exact discriminator can make additional blocking unnecessary.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after changed participant/task mix, site, baseline severity, target weights or effect modification.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y03</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D109

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D109</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/108</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-AB</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D109</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Joint work and construct scope define the blocking target</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>POPULATION_AND_EFFECT_MODIFIER_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-16</p></li><li><p>ECSE-17</p></li><li><p>ECSE-41</p></li><li><p>ECSE-42</p></li><li><p>ECSE-43</p></li><li><p>ECSE-44</p></li><li><p>ECSE-46</p></li><li><p>ECSE-47</p></li><li><p>ECSE-48</p></li><li><p>ECSE-49</p></li><li><p>ECSE-50</p></li><li><p>ECSE-51</p></li><li><p>ECSE-53</p></li><li><p>ECSE-55</p></li><li><p>ECSE-56</p></li><li><p>ECSE-60</p></li><li><p>ECSE-62</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P031</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Which pre-treatment difference is nuisance, a relevant modifier or a different target?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The native comparison supplies actual users/teams, task and event classes, intended construct, outcome distribution, implementation context or resource burden. Those inputs determine meaningful strata and whether a difference must be reported rather than adjusted away.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>P031 is used in that same empirical comparison and the proposed grouping variable is genuinely pre-treatment. A cognitive label alone does not create a blocking factor.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>The target definition does not establish good randomization, measurement, unit independence or sufficient within-block information.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Omit unhelpful blocks; retain direct adequate comparisons or an existing balanced design.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen on altered unit, construct, target population or treatment-by-context effects.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y03</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D110</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/109</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BC</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D110</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Pre-treatment heterogeneity constrains empirical safety comparisons</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>COMPARATIVE_EVIDENCE_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P031</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-015</p></li><li><p>ESS-032</p></li><li><p>ESS-040</p></li><li><p>ESS-041</p></li><li><p>ESS-042</p></li><li><p>ESS-045</p></li><li><p>ESS-049</p></li><li><p>ESS-053</p></li><li><p>ESS-054</p></li><li><p>ESS-058</p></li><li><p>ESS-063</p></li><li><p>ESS-065</p></li><li><p>ESS-067</p></li><li><p>ESS-068</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Does the claimed difference in method, control or safety indicator survive the relevant baseline composition?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Known pre-treatment exposure, site, operating-mode or participant differences can alter a comparative effectiveness or indicator claim. Blocking/stratification supplies a scoped design input, not a hazard model or an authority to expose people to harm.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The receiving claim uses an empirical comparison of the same method/control/indicator under consequential known heterogeneity. ## D114

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D114</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/113</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D114</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Stopping and observation cost constrain repeated cognitive comparisons</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>SEQUENTIAL_EVIDENCE_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P038</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-41</p></li><li><p>ECSE-42</p></li><li><p>ECSE-43</p></li><li><p>ECSE-44</p></li><li><p>ECSE-46</p></li><li><p>ECSE-47</p></li><li><p>ECSE-48</p></li><li><p>ECSE-51</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>What may this repeatedly inspected comparison claim when it stops?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The chosen stopping rule and actual guarantee limit repeated comparative inference, while prospective learning value and total cost inform further observation. An individual probe’s meaning remains distinct from its repeated statistical use.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The cognitive evaluation repeatedly inspects accumulating evidence or chooses further data under a stated decision/learning objective.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Measurement, target, action authority and external validity remain. Anytime validity is available only under the selected method’s actual conditions.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>A fixed-horizon design, a complete direct answer or a bounded noninferential learning cadence can suffice.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after endpoint, stopping, evaluator, horizon or data-generating changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X02</p></li><li><p>X09</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D116

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D116</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/115</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D116</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Interaction and alias structure qualify implementation comparisons</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>FACTOR_INTERACTION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P033</p></li><li><p>P034</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-46</p></li><li><p>ECSE-47</p></li><li><p>ECSE-48</p></li><li><p>ECSE-42</p></li><li><p>ECSE-43</p></li><li><p>ECSE-44</p></li><li><p>ECSE-51</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Can display-by-task, training-by-context or bundle-component interactions change this implementation comparison?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>Factorial contrasts and explicit fractional aliases constrain the same multi-factor EID, CRM or handoff-bundle effect claim. Pure construct definitions and one descriptive measure remain outside the guard.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The implementation comparison actually has multiple controllable factors and a plausible consequential interaction; P034 additionally requires a fractional design whose aliases matter.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Representative tasks, valid outcomes, safe intervention, units and implementation fidelity remain.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>One dominant known factor, adequate mechanism evidence, direct enumeration or exclusion of the rival may avoid extra factorial runs.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after added component, context factor or plausible interaction.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X10</p></li><li><p>Y03</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd><dt>Additional member reason</dt><dd><ol><li><p>For an actual multi-factor measurement comparison, probe-by-task, information-by-team and reporting-condition interactions are also specific rivals. Pure construct definitions and one descriptive measure remain outside the guard.</p></li></ol></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D130

## D134

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D134</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/133</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BC</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D134</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>A capability summary cannot substitute for current state or capability</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>CAPABILITY_INTERPRETATION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P019</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ESS-009</p></li><li><p>ESS-010</p></li><li><p>ESS-016</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>What does this capability index actually establish for the credited control?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The conditional index prerequisites and specification-based meaning bound its use as evidence in current feedback, process-model assumptions or a human/automation performance allocation. ## D137

If a known deterministic state already settles that duty, an extra chart can have no relevant role.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>A specific chart is genuinely proposed for that same duty; no group member supplies another member’s authority or dynamics.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Having a consumer does not establish a repeatable baseline, measurement fitness or calibrated change detection.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Retain the adequate direct or passive path and omit redundant charting.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after the duty, monitored process, response horizon or adequate alternative changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>X01</p></li><li><p>X02</p></li><li><p>Y06</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D138

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D138</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/137</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D138</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Local optimization constrains joint-work design</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>LOCAL_DESIGN_AND_CONFIRMATION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P035</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-41</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>What can a fitted optimum support for joint-work design?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>When a continuous display or workflow setting is genuinely optimized against the actual time, quality, recovery and distribution of work outcomes, P035 supplies local model checking, sequential-design discipline, independent confirmation and robustness/boundary limits. A component score optimum is not a joint-work optimum.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The same design really has controllable quantitative factors, an expensive-run decision and a sufficiently smooth local objective; these conditions must be justified, not inferred from the cognitive method name.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>The native construct, work unit, implementation, safety constraints and real effect remain separate premises. A finite analytical illustration does not establish any actual response surface.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Use a cheap exhaustive discrete comparison, a mechanistically known optimum, an adequate existing design or a narrow descriptive measure when it settles the actual question.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after the factor region, response definition, target population, model form or confirmation context changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y05</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

No hazardous experiment is licensed.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>A settled optimum, adequate existing design, one sufficient measure or cheap discrete enumeration removes the response-surface burden.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after work purpose, construct, user/task distribution, implementation or constraints change.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y05</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D146

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D146</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/145</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D146</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Local optimization constrains ecological display implementation</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>LOCAL_DESIGN_AND_CONFIRMATION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P035</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-46</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>What can a fitted optimum support for ecological display implementation?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>When a continuous density, scaling or update setting in a specified display is genuinely optimized against the representative user and routine/nonprocedural task outcomes versus adequate alternatives, P035 supplies local model checking, sequential-design discipline, independent confirmation and robustness/boundary limits. The result is local to that implementation and task region, not superiority of the EID family.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The same design really has controllable quantitative factors, an expensive-run decision and a sufficiently smooth local objective; these conditions must be justified, not inferred from the cognitive method name.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>The native construct, work unit, implementation, safety constraints and real effect remain separate premises. A finite analytical illustration does not establish any actual response surface.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Use a cheap exhaustive discrete comparison, a mechanistically known optimum, an adequate existing design or a narrow descriptive measure when it settles the actual question.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after the factor region, response definition, target population, model form or confirmation context changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y05</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>
