No hazardous experiment is licensed.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>A settled optimum, adequate existing design, one sufficient measure or cheap discrete enumeration removes the response-surface burden.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after work purpose, construct, user/task distribution, implementation or constraints change.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y05</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D154

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D154</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/153</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D154</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>Process-report semantics separate observation from inference</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>EVIDENCE_INTERPRETATION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P015</p></li><li><p>P017</p></li><li><p>P018</p></li><li><p>P019</p></li><li><p>P020</p></li><li><p>P021</p></li><li><p>P022</p></li><li><p>P024</p></li><li><p>P059</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-24</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Which statements in this shared process report are observed, modeled or required?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>For the actual report, the individual monitor property identifies its own distinction: signal versus cause, natural band versus requirement, conditional forecast/index versus fact, noise versus intervention evidence, design tradeoff, dynamic baseline, specialized-model inference or merely proposed chart. This changes the common factual reference and visible disagreements.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>Participants actually share that particular statistical field or conclusion for joint action. Native distinctions are not pooled into every member and no actual calibration is supplied by labels.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Valid statistical interpretation does not ensure participants see, understand or agree on the field; actual communication and contested interpretations remain.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>A direct clearly observed fact and ordinary shared note can settle a modest task without a statistical report.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after field meaning, provenance, model, forecast horizon or the participants’ decision changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y06</p></li><li><p>Y04</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D155

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D155</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/154</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-AB</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D155</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>The shared factual question determines the report claim</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>OBSERVATION_AND_INTERPRETATION_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-24</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P015</p></li><li><p>P017</p></li><li><p>P018</p></li><li><p>P019</p></li><li><p>P020</p></li><li><p>P021</p></li><li><p>P022</p></li><li><p>P024</p></li><li><p>P059</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Which observed record or contested inference is the monitor analysis meant to address?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The actual shared reference distinguishes the observed value, asserted model/requirement and disputed inference. This identifies which baseline, specification, forecast, index or adjustment claim the named statistical criterion must examine and prevents accidental conflation of different claims.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>The same process-report field is a consequential common reference; generic agreement is not statistical evidence.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Shared definitions cannot establish measurement validity, baseline calibration, distribution assumptions or causal identity.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>A direct unambiguous authoritative observation can remove the modeled-report question.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after changed field definition, disagreement, model version or intended action.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y06</p></li><li><p>Y04</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D156

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D156</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/155</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-BA</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D156</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>A chosen quantitative cross-check has a specific discrimination limit</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>CROSSCHECK_MECHANISM_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P015</p></li><li><p>P017</p></li><li><p>P018</p></li><li><p>P019</p></li><li><p>P020</p></li><li><p>P021</p></li><li><p>P022</p></li><li><p>P024</p></li><li><p>P059</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-38</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>Can this proposed monitor-based check detect the consequential error?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>When the actual check uses the named monitoring, limit, forecast, index or adjustment criterion, its specific assumptions and discrimination restrict the error the check can detect. Checking a natural band cannot establish conformance; repeating a conditional forecast cannot establish current state; an uncalibrated chart may add no useful discrimination.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>That exact quantitative method is actually selected as the additional cross-check for its own named failure mechanism, not merely available somewhere in the system.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>The check’s independent information, timing, competent execution and total cost remain; two labels for the same flawed cue are not independent evidence.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>One adequate direct measurement, an independent method that detects the actual error or omission of a redundant check can suffice.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen after the error mechanism, information source, method assumptions, deadline or cost changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y06</p></li><li><p>X06</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D157

<dl><dt>Id</dt><dd><p>D157</p></dd><dt>Source</dt><dd><dl><dt>Filename</dt><dd><p>RELATION_RULES.json</p></dd><dt>Sha256</dt><dd><p>f8fda213dbd1b33ed7b78b9c6c04eaf9515649b51f6434b8d987a97af9dbd97c</p></dd><dt>Pointer</dt><dd><p>/rules/156</p></dd></dl></dd><dt>Narrative sections</dt><dd><ol><li><p>GUARDS</p></li><li><p>GROUPS</p></li><li><p>D-AB</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Record</dt><dd><dl><dt>Rule id</dt><dd><p>D157</p></dd><dt>Name</dt><dd><p>The error to cross-check defines the quantitative consumer</p></dd><dt>Relation type</dt><dd><p>DISCRIMINATOR_PURPOSE_INPUT</p></dd><dt>Source members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>ECSE-38</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Receiving members</dt><dd><ol><li><p>P015</p></li><li><p>P017</p></li><li><p>P018</p></li><li><p>P019</p></li><li><p>P020</p></li><li><p>P021</p></li><li><p>P022</p></li><li><p>P024</p></li><li><p>P059</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Shared question</dt><dd><p>What error must this actual monitor-based cross-check distinguish?</p></dd><dt>Contribution</dt><dd><p>The consequential error and needed diversity/timing define the exact contrast and consumer for the proposed monitor, conformance interpretation, forecast, index or adjustment analysis. A check intended to establish present conformance cannot be satisfied by a different historical-summary target.</p></dd><dt>Guard</dt><dd><p>A specific quantitative check of that failure mechanism is proposed; independent-check language alone supplies no calibrated stream.</p></dd><dt>Remaining premises</dt><dd><p>Actual model validity and measurement evidence remain necessary; the cognitive criterion does not calculate a detection guarantee.</p></dd><dt>Counter control and nontrigger</dt><dd><p>Use an already sufficient direct discriminator or a cheaper adequate check; do not add method diversity with no relevant discrimination.</p></dd><dt>Reentry</dt><dd><p>Reopen when error class, chosen check, information overlap or practical horizon changes.</p></dd><dt>Case refs</dt><dd><ol><li><p>Y06</p></li><li><p>X06</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Evidence status</dt><dd><p>EXAMINED_CONDITIONAL_ANALYTICAL_RELATION</p></dd><dt>Authority limit</dt><dd><p>No criterion, model, evidence item or source citation grants operating, change, risk-acceptance or waiver authority.</p></dd><dt>Basis fields</dt><dd><ol><li><p>MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM</p></li><li><p>MECHANISM</p></li><li><p>TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT</p></li><li><p>NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH</p></li></ol></dd><dt>Source ceiling</dt><dd><p>Exact qualified constituent predicates and recorded evidence ceilings; this synthesis adds an analytical interface, not empirical validation of a bundle.</p></dd><dt>Revision origin</dt><dd><p>R2 owner-level repair and same-premise sibling comparison after CSSS-FID-001; see REPAIR_BLOCK_STUDY.json.</p></dd><dt>No automatic reverse</dt><dd><p>The reverse, where present, has its own evidence/constraint output and guard; no symmetry is inferred.</p></dd></dl></dd></dl>

## D158

evidence remains conditional on that exact failure definition, exposure and detection role, never completeness of FMEA.</p></dd><dt>Ess-006</dt><dd><p>A defined top event or post-initiator branch actually consumes this quantitative condition, regime, adjustment mechanism or detector delay; the causal logic defines the event and dependence question rather than being inferred from a signal.</p></dd><dt>Ess-007</dt><dd><p>A real process node/deviation uses the stated limit, forecast, detection or adjustment condition; the node, consequence and response specify what deviation matters. A guideword alone supplies no calibrated distribution.</p></dd><dt>Ess-008</dt><dd><p>The actual controller/process/context contains this monitoring or adjustment policy; the quantitative conditions expose a possible unsafe action/context and the scenario specifies the relevant statistical consequence.</p></dd><dt>Ess-009</dt><dd><p>The same feedback/control path consumes the actual statistical state or policy; achieved-state evidence, freshness and fallback conditions remain separate requirements.</p></dd><dt>Ess-010</dt><dd><p>An actual safety process-model/mode assumption consumes the forecast or monitor result and changes after adjustment; its scope, divergence and fail-bounded use define the quantitative target.</p></dd><dt>Ess-011</dt><dd><p>The actual control path has timing, order, duration, repetition and transition requirements; the statistic&#x27;s horizon and intervention cadence must match them and its uncertainty cannot create a deadline waiver.</p></dd><dt>Ess-012</dt><dd><p>A specific interface contract relies on a statistical regime, detection property, margin or adjustment assumption; the version-bound assumption identifies the actual cross-boundary quantitative consumer.</p></dd><dt>Ess-013</dt><dd><p>The actual common-cause claim involves shared monitored streams, regimes or adjustment resources; those dependencies and observation requirements bound the credited statistical/evidence contribution without manufacturing independence.</p></dd><dt>Ess-014</dt><dd><p>A real redundancy architecture uses the quantitative failure/health or adjustment policy and its arbitration/maintenance work; actual dependencies and degraded-mode duties specify the needed statistical claim.</p></dd><dt>Ess-015</dt><dd><p>A selected quantitative monitor/forecast or adjustment-mechanism analysis is proposed to cover a named causal question in the actual method portfolio; its supported and omitted phenomena determine contribution, not method count.</p></dd><dt>Ess-016</dt><dd><p>The actual human-automation safety role receives the quantitative cue or adjustment work; realistic joint capability, state visibility, takeover and fallback authority bound its use.</p></dd><dt>Ess-017</dt><dd><p>A named enforcement actor is credited with using this information and doing its resulting work; the actual competence/information/stop/handoff requirements constrain the policy while no statistical result grants rights.</p></dd><dt>Ess-018</dt><dd><p>This quantitative evidence item is actually linked to a hazard/constraint/control claim; its precise condition and supported scope determine what the link can assert, and that hazard-linked target supplies the evidence consumer.</p></dd><dt>Ess-019</dt><dd><p>The actual risk representation uses this process evidence or adjustment consequence; consequence, exposure and uncertainty remain separate, and no score or typical band substitutes for the risk claim.</p></dd><dt>Ess-020</dt><dd><p>The actual choice of control strength consumes predicted observability/recovery, quantitative margin or monitor/adjustment burden; real consequence, coupling, reversibility and latency delimit its proportionality calculation.</p></dd><dt>Ess-021</dt><dd><p>The residual-risk decision actually consumes this quantitative evidence and policy alternatives; its exposure/configuration/time scope and competent authority constrain the offered claim without being supplied by arithmetic.</p></dd><dt>Ess-022</dt><dd><p>A real feasible-control comparison uses this detection/forecast/adjustment evidence and total sacrifice; binding good practice and actual consequence remain constraints, and no imported numerical rule creates legal acceptability.</p></dd><dt>Ess-023</dt><dd><p>An actual barrier layer has the monitored health, future availability or adjustment process at issue; distinct barrier functions, common causes and escalation duties identify what the statistic must support.</p></dd><dt>Ess-024</dt><dd><p>A specified safety function&#x27;s integrity/assurance argument actually uses this quantitative evidence or monitor; hazard-derived function/exposure and domain objectives delimit that contribution, never a numerical certificate of total safety.</p></dd><dt>Ess-025</dt><dd><p>A chosen quantitative evidence channel is credited with detecting a named error/failure; its exact discrimination and regime scope bound its information, while the actual assurance target/dependence claim sets its consumer.</p></dd><dt>Ess-026</dt><dd><p>The actual assurance argument uses this specific quantitative premise or adjustment result; its supported meaning, uncertainty and decision scope change the argument, whose claim specifies the relevant statistical target.</p></dd><dt>Ess-027</dt><dd><p>A real defeater concerns this stream, forecast, index or intervention premise; its exact counterevidence and closure criterion delimit what the statistical result could resolve, not a generic demand for another review.</p></dd><dt>Ess-028</dt><dd><p>The reused evidence is this actual statistical result/policy under a stated configuration and environment; regime/meaning changes affect reuse and the identified actual configuration determines the statistical population.</p></dd><dt>Ess-029</dt><dd><p>A concrete change affects this quantitative premise, monitor or adjustment policy; regime and intervention effects delimit the affected frontier while the hazard/control dependency defines what needs reassessment.</p></dd><dt>Ess-030</dt><dd><p>The actual live assurance claim relies on this monitored/predicted premise; its useful time horizon, change trigger and response burden delimit the statistical procedure.</p></dd><dt>Ess-031</dt><dd><p>A scoped independent assessment actually uses this quantitative check to expose a particular failure; discrimination and limits bound its credit while the assessor&#x27;s real question and access constrain what can be concluded.</p></dd><dt>Ess-032</dt><dd><p>The actual selected quantitative evidence supports a precise hazard-linked model/system claim; the claim&#x27;s bearer and correspondence burden constrain its target, and statistical evidence never converts a model theorem into a physical guarantee.</p></dd><dt>Ess-033</dt><dd><p>The actual monitoring/adjustment policy shares a safety-security feedback, access or availability path; its change/response consequences enter that common path and the named threat/control constraint bounds the policy.</p></dd><dt>Ess-034</dt><dd><p>A real hazard detector routes an actionable response from this stream or forecast; its false/missed/late behavior and total alarm burden enter the specific control path.</p></dd><dt>Ess-035</dt><dd><p>The actual containment/isolation/stop decision uses the quantitative condition or adjustment; resulting state, actuation and side effects remain separate, and the required controlled state supplies the statistical criterion.</p></dd><dt>Ess-036</dt><dd><p>A real continued-service/degradation choice uses the performance forecast or monitor/adjustment policy; competing service loss and credible fallback specify its target and constraints.</p></dd><dt>Ess-037</dt><dd><p>The actual restart/recovery decision uses the evidence or adjustment; restoration of the particular constraint and recovery dependencies define what must be established, beyond a normal-looking history.</p></dd><dt>Ess-038</dt><dd><p>Exceptional operation actually relies on a quantitative premise or compensating monitoring/adjustment control; exposure, expiry, degraded function and current authority define its horizon and action boundary.</p></dd><dt>Ess-039</dt><dd><p>The actual report/precursor stream is interpreted or triggers adjustment; exposure, incentives, reportability and its hazard/control consumer determine what a change signal or forecast may mean.</p></dd><dt>Ess-040</dt><dd><p>A concrete causal investigation uses these contemporaneous quantitative observations or evaluates an adjustment; signal-versus-cause and regime limits constrain attribution while the actual competing mechanisms define the evidence need.</p></dd><dt>Ess-041</dt><dd><p>A proposed corrective adjustment and its expected indicator are actually monitored for effectiveness and side effects; valid change interpretation and intervention risk matter, while the real mechanism/owner defines its target.</p></dd><dt>Ess-042</dt><dd><p>The actual leading indicator has a hazard-linked denominator, threshold and action consumer; process-change, prediction and intervention semantics directly constrain that indicator&#x27;s meaning and use.</p></dd><dt>Ess-043</dt><dd><p>A real upstream management/incentive policy uses the metric/forecast or changes monitoring and adjustment demands; its decision/control path, production pressure and boundary migration define the quantitative consumer and costs.</p></dd><dt>Ess-044</dt><dd><p>The supplier&#x27;s actual performance/condition evidence, anomaly notification or adjustment policy enters an interface obligation; the integrated function and exposure define its accepted scope, not supplier-level quality alone.</p></dd><dt>Ess-045</dt><dd><p>The actual adaptive safety envelope uses this stream, forecast, limit or adjustment; required boundaries, temporal validity, actuation and legitimate revision authority constrain the quantitative policy.</p></dd><dt>Ess-047</dt><dd><p>The actual control being retained or retired is this monitor, forecast artefact or adjustment procedure; its contribution, validity and latent hazard duty determine retirement, which cannot follow merely from no recent incidents.</p></dd><dt>Ess-048</dt><dd><p>This quantitative artefact/control has a current or credibly latent safety consumer; its precise information and response cost determine value while the duty/consumer specifies what the statistic must answer.</p></dd><dt>Ess-049</dt><dd><p>The actual control comparison includes monitoring/adjustment or its replacement by elimination/physical constraint; the quantitative limitation and control-created hazards inform that comparison, without reversing a binding hierarchy.</p></dd><dt>Ess-050</dt><dd><p>The actual safety margin/envelope uses this measured or predicted quantity and adjustment; required separation is distinct from normal variability and the real boundary specifies the statistical decision.</p></dd><dt>Ess-051</dt><dd><p>A named claim-critical assumption is actually checked by this stream, forecast or monitor; the validity period and consequence of assumption failure determine the statistical target and useful response.</p></dd><dt>Ess-052</dt><dd><p>The durable current decision state actually contains this quantitative evidence, assumption or adjustment obligation; preserving its meaning/currentness changes the content to retain and the consumer defines the needed statement.</p></dd><dt>Ess-053</dt><dd><p>The integrated control&#x27;s achieved-state verification uses this evidence or intervention; the exact intended state and correspondence burden define the statistical target, independent of model validity alone.</p></dd><dt>Ess-054</dt><dd><p>A real lifecycle transition or temporary configuration uses the quantitative premise or adjustment; altered context, expiry, actor work and verification requirement define its regime and timing.</p></dd><dt>Ess-055</dt><dd><p>The actual quantitative process input is being interpreted in a risk representation; its scoped meaning cannot make an ordinal cell cardinal risk, and the genuine consequence/uncertainty question specifies the input. This is not charting arbitrary numeric codes for cells.</p></dd><dt>Ess-056</dt><dd><p>The actual disputed process depth includes this recurring monitor, prediction artefact or tuning rule; its discrimination and total cost matter to the affected claim, while consequence/coupling determine when deeper work is justified.</p></dd><dt>Ess-057</dt><dd><p>This actual quantitative evidence or monitoring premise is credited under a certification/current-safety claim; common causes, added interactions and arbitration duties delimit quantitative credit rather than channel count.</p></dd><dt>Ess-061</dt><dd><p>This particular quantitative evidence item is counted as assurance;
